basic_info.description: Welcome to 20 Marietta Drive, a beautiful detached home in sought-after Miraloma Park. Thoughtfully designed, this residence seamlessly blends style, comfort, and functionality for modern living. Offering approximately 2,420 square feet of living space, the home features four spacious bedrooms,including two primary suites, one on each level, and four full bathrooms. The airy and light-filled layout creates an inviting atmosphere throughout. The kitchen boasts a large island, a Thermador range and refrigerator, quartz counters, and a very spacious dining area. The living room features custom built-in shelving and storage, a fireplace, and easy access to the private, and very useable, outdoor retreat. Two bedrooms and bath complete this level. The lower level offers a generous family room, two full bath, and two bedrooms, including a primary suite with a luxurious bathroom featuring a separate Jacuzzi tub and shower, double sinks, and a built-in vanity. The beautiful backyard includes a patio and a dining area, making the outdoor space both peaceful and functional. Additional features include a one-car garage with interior access and storage. Set on a 3,397 sq.ft. lot, 20 Marietta offers the perfect balance of serene living and urban convenience.Minutes from transportation, shops.
